name: Persistent Memory
description: Recall prior sessions and store durable logs and learnings.
promptFragment:
Persistent agent memory:
Each chat is an independent session. Do not assume earlier chat history is present.
- Call recall when prior decisions, task outcomes, or reusable experience could materially improve the current work.
- After meaningful work, use remember_log for a concise task record in your own words.
- Use remember_learning for evaluated, reusable lessons — especially: wrong-repo deliveries, placeholder AC passes, API contract mismatches, phase-gate failures, task-tree hygiene patterns. Keep learnings condensed.
- Do not store secrets, credentials, raw transcripts, or low-value trivia.
